main_text.p: [?]que illi viri, in prælio contra Timotheum Gennæum, 380etiam ab ipsis hostibus visi, aureis armis conspicui: quorum duo Macchabæi stipabant, & telis hostes profligabant. †.Macch.4.&†. Nec dubitandum, ipsum met Dei filium Judæ adjuvisse exercitum in recuperando templo Hierosolymitano, in evertendâ Jovis Olympii statua, in abolendis Bacchanalibus, & aliis abominandis ritibus. Sic & Zonaras lib.3. memorat, CONSTANTINUM Magnum in præliis cum Licinio & Maxentio commissis, 312vidisse armatum equitem, signum CRUCIS pro vexillo 324ante aciem suam præferente: ac rursus Adrianopoli duos eis visos adolescentes, qui hostium phalanges cædebant: item circa Byzantium noctu, omnibus dormientibus, conspectum ab eo ignem, qui fulguris instar valem exercitus sui colluströret. Nicephorus lib.7. hist. Eccles. cap.50. tradit, Michaelem in trajectu Bosporì CONSTANTINO Magno in somnis apparuisse: & his 330cum allocutum verbis: Ego sum Michaël Archidux Domini Zebaoth virtutum, Christianorum fidei tutor, qui tibi contra impios tyrannos belligeranti auxiliaria arma contuli. Sic & cum TIGRANES Armeniæ Rex, socerî sui Mithridatis Ponti Regis calamitate permotus, contra Romanos exercitum 250000 educeret: immensæ iftæ copiæ, quibus superbus Rex magis confidebat, quàm divino auxilio, Romanorum impetum non sustinentes, profligatæ sunt antè, quàm certamen iniretur. Et narrat Plutarchus in Lucullo, eâ in fugâ ex tanto exercitu cecidisse ultra centena millia peditum, ex equitibus verò, quorum 50000 fuerant, evasisse admodum paucos: ex Romanis verò cæsos esse tantum quinque, & vulneratos centum.

page.notes: Left edge of the page is cut and the first word is partly lost; the opening letter is doubtful. The Greek citation marks "†" stand for the printed Greek-letter sigla and are doubtful. The right-margin numbers (380, 312, 324, 330, 390) are read from a faint scan and may be misread; the asterisks after them are not certain. "Michaël" and "fum" were read as printed, with long s normalised to s. Some ink is faint along the lower lines. No catchword is visible.
